permutationProtocol.prng: xorshift32, unsigned shifts 13 left, 17 right, 5 left. Scenario seed = uint32(1729 XOR FNV-1a-32 of ASCII scenario ID), replacing zero with one. FNV offset 2166136261, multiplier 16777619.
permutationProtocol.shuffle: A separate continuing PRNG stream per scenario. Start every trial with the original expanded order; Fisher-Yates descending i=n-1..1. For bound b=i+1 draw uint32 x until x < 2^32-(2^32 mod b), then swap i with x mod b. Record start/end state and every full permutation.
permutationProtocol.pairing: Identical incoming permutation for all six methods in a trial. Sorted methods may deliberately ignore that order.
permutationProtocol.counts: 80 paired cases, 480 trial-method results, plus 24 authored-order method results.
permutationProtocol.reference_difference: Seed 1729, 20 repetitions, all four scenarios and all three reference controls are preserved. This original JS PRNG is not Python random; do not claim reproduction of unexecuted reference permutation arrays.
